purpose: Separate finer action duration from shorter input history using one frozen learned policy; diagnostic only, not a training or promotion path.

compatibility_gate.require: Exact full game dictionaries equal the archived source primary before running either arm.

nominal_time_caveat: HUD-settling T-states are additional; shorter decisions also change action RNG draw count and trajectory.
execution: Run compatibility gate then adjacent then spaced; only one probe process at once alongside the sole unchanged cap128k learner. No early outcome selection, rate/history sweep, optimizer changes, imported trajectories, or final-test seeds.
policy: Unmodified learned categorical sampling with each game's existing RNG; screen-only history adaptation, no scripted steering or serve overrides.
decision_rule: Report all two-arm results and completion, mean/median/best, level counts. Any incomplete arm is disqualified as a whole. Even a complete improvement is diagnostic only until end-to-end training/evaluation/replay inspection support and standard revalidation; do not promote or touch fresh seeds.
